pumac-2013-number-theory-a-07.prompt: Suppose $P(x)$ is a degree $n$ monic polynomial with integer coefficients such that $2013$ divides $P(r)$ for exactly $1000$ values of $r$ between $1$ and $2013$ inclusive. Find the minimum value of $n$.

pumac-2013-number-theory-a-08.prompt: Find the number of primes $p$ between $100$ and $200$ for which $x^{11}+y^{16}\equiv2013\pmod p$ has a solution in integers $x$ and $y$.
